sentences.en: So he does what he always does, which is to start to interview people intensively.
sentences.zh: 他做了他一贯的做法，那就是开始密集地采访相关人员。

sentences.en: And he wants to talk to all the people who knew Prince well to try to understand what was driving him.
sentences.zh: 他想和所有了解Prince的人交谈，试图理解是什么在驱动着他。

sentences.en: What was he thinking about?
sentences.zh: 他在想什么？

sentences.en: What were his torments?
sentences.zh: 他的痛苦是什么？

sentences.en: What were his successes?
sentences.zh: 他的成就是什么？

sentences.en: And he seeks out kind of everybody in Prince's world, from, you know, bodyguards to family members to dear friends to many, many collaborators over the years.
sentences.zh: 他寻找了Prince世界里的每一个人，从保镖到家人，到挚友，再到多年来的许多合作者。

sentences.en: You know, like, look, somebody who was around him for decades and met with us before we started filming basically was like, good luck.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你看，一个在他身边待了几十年，在我们要开始拍摄前和我们见面的人，基本上就是说，祝你好运。

sentences.en: And what he and his team begin to find is basically another locked door, another wall.
sentences.zh: 而他和他的团队开始发现的，基本上是又一扇锁上的门，又一堵墙。

sentences.en: People, you know, people who were around him were not at liberty necessarily to talk freely and publicly, whether they wanted to or not.
sentences.zh: 人们，你知道，那些在他身边的人，未必有自由去公开、自由地谈论他，无论他们是否愿意。

sentences.en: So people are very reluctant to speak candidly about Prince.
sentences.zh: 所以人们非常不愿坦诚地谈论Prince。

sentences.en: They're protective.
sentences.zh: 他们有防备心。

sentences.en: Some people seem scared.
sentences.zh: 有些人看起来很害怕。

sentences.en: Even in death, people were reluctant because I think it's a natural inclination of some people whose names are made, were made because of their connection to him.
sentences.zh: 即使在他死后，人们依然不愿开口，因为我认为，对于一些因与他有关而声名鹊起的人来说，这是一种本能的倾向。

sentences.en: So do I want to sully that through talking honestly?
sentences.zh: 所以我真的想通过诚实的谈话来玷污这一点吗？

sentences.en: I mean, it's not that unusual in a way for a world famous celebrity, you know, for people not to want to talk about them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对于一个世界闻名的名人来说，人们不想谈论他们，这在某种程度上并不罕见。

sentences.en: But it was very intense and, you know, it seemed across the board universal, this reluctance.
sentences.zh: 但这种不情愿非常强烈，而且，你知道，似乎是普遍存在的。

sentences.en: And Ezra and his team started to wonder, like, what's the big secret here?
sentences.zh: Ezra和他的团队开始纳闷，这里面到底有什么天大的秘密？

sentences.en: You know, is there some secret that people won't tell us?
sentences.zh: 你知道，是不是有什么秘密是人们不愿告诉我们的？

sentences.en: And in fact, after many, many years of really persuasion and building truSt.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在经过多年坚持不懈的劝说和建立信任之后。

sentences.en: At the same time, people had a lot to say once they sat down because they had not really talked openly about him.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一旦人们坐下来，他们有很多话要说，因为他们之前从未真正公开谈论过他。

sentences.en: People slowly did begin to talk.
sentences.zh: 人们慢慢地开始开口了。

sentences.en: You start to investigate who the person was and you realize there are these chapters in his life.
sentences.zh: 当你开始调查这个人是谁时，你会意识到他的人生中有这些篇章。

sentences.en: At a certain point, he had interviewed enough people, over 75 people, to start to get a clearer picture of Prince.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，他已经采访了足够多的人，超过75人，开始对Prince有了更清晰的认识。

sentences.en: And to be able to marry a narrative of Prince's life from the beginning really to the end, where he died in a very mysterious way, with this footage that was in the vault.
sentences.zh: 并能够将Prince从始至终的人生叙事——他以一种非常神秘的方式去世——与保险库里的这些录像结合起来。

sentences.en: And it's not that there's a secret, but there's a complex, tortured, deeply traumatized person alongside the musical genius.
sentences.zh: 并不是说有什么秘密，而是除了音乐天才之外，还有一个复杂、受折磨、深受创伤的人。

sentences.en: And eventually, Ezra had what he felt was a solid cut of the film, and I was able to watch it.
sentences.zh: 最终，Ezra有了他认为剪辑扎实的电影版本，我也得以观看。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And what did you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得怎么样？

sentences.en: It's a masterpiece.
sentences.zh: 这是一部杰作。

sentences.en: And what makes you say that?
sentences.zh: 是什么让你这么说？

sentences.en: Well, one of the things the film does so well is tell the story of Prince's childhood.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这部电影做得非常出色的一点是讲述了Prince的童年故事。

sentences.en: And it's maybe worth saying that it doesn't unfold the story in a linear way.
sentences.zh: 值得一提的是，它并没有以线性的方式展开故事。

sentences.en: It accumulates through the interviews, through all of the different people he speaks to, his lovers, his sister, his friends.
sentences.zh: 它是通过采访，通过他交谈过的所有不同的人——他的爱人、他的妹妹、他的朋友——一点点积累起来的。

sentences.en: And what you see is a picture of a boy.
sentences.zh: 你所看到的是一个男孩的画像。

sentences.en: First of all, he had, according to several testimonies in the film, a troubled relationship with his parents.
sentences.zh: 首先，根据片中多位证人的说法，他和父母的关系很糟糕。

sentences.en: There was violence in the home.
sentences.zh: 家里存在暴力。

sentences.en: His parents split when he was a kid.
sentences.zh: 他小时候父母就分开了。

sentences.en: First, he was living with his mother.
sentences.zh: 起初，他和母亲住在一起。

sentences.en: She then remarried.
sentences.zh: 后来她再婚了。

sentences.en: And two people in the film say that Prince told them that when he was a kid, his stepfather shut him in a room or a closet for six weeks.
sentences.zh: 片中有两个人说，Prince告诉他们，他小时候，继父曾把他关在一个房间或壁橱里长达六周。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And he came out changed?
sentences.zh: 他出来后变了吗？

sentences.en: How could he not?
sentences.zh: 他怎么可能不变？

sentences.en: How could he not?
sentences.zh: 他怎么可能不变？

sentences.en: And then when he was 12, his mother kicked him out of the house and sent him to live with his father.
sentences.zh: 后来在他12岁时，母亲把他赶出了家门，送去和他父亲住。

sentences.en: He was very close to his father.
sentences.zh: 他和父亲很亲近。

sentences.en: His father was a musician.
sentences.zh: 他父亲是个音乐家。

sentences.en: And he was a very religious man.
sentences.zh: 而且是个非常虔诚的人。

sentences.en: He was a strict man, kind of an authoritarian parent.
sentences.zh: 他是个严厉的人，算是个专制的家长。

sentences.en: And he found Prince in a room with a girl a couple times.
sentences.zh: 他有几次发现Prince和一个女孩在房间里。

sentences.en: And he, too, kicked Prince out when Prince was 14 years old.
sentences.zh: 于是，在Prince 14岁时，他也把Prince赶了出去。

sentences.en: So he was an abandoned person.
sentences.zh: 所以他是一个被遗弃的人。

sentences.en: And that abandonment and the dissolution of his family and the feeling of neglect, according to the many people who knew him, was a real through line in his life.
sentences.zh: 据许多了解他的人说，这种被遗弃感、家庭的解体以及被忽视的感觉，是他生命中真正的一条主线。

sentences.en: This drove Prince to his own unstable sort of familial and love relationships.
sentences.zh: 这导致Prince自己陷入了不稳定的家庭和恋爱关系中。

sentences.en: And one pattern that you see in the film over the course of Prince's life is that he would kind of assemble families around himself in the form of collaborators and bandmates.
sentences.zh: 你在片中看到的Prince一生中的一个模式是，他会通过合作者和乐队成员，在自己周围组建家庭。

sentences.en: But he would always really challenge those relationships to the point of breaking.
sentences.zh: 但他总是会真正挑战这些关系，直到破裂。

sentences.en: He was distrustful.
sentences.zh: 他不信任别人。

sentences.en: He was demanding.
sentences.zh: 他要求苛刻。

sentences.en: A couple of his close collaborators say that when they asked for a raise, Prince said to them, if you really loved me, you wouldn't ask me for a raise.
sentences.zh: 他的一些亲密合作者说，当他们要求加薪时，Prince对他们说，如果你真的爱我，你就不会要求加薪。

sentences.en: He was really controlling with his girlfriends.
sentences.zh: 他对女友的控制欲非常强。

sentences.en: With one girlfriend, he tried to prevent her from seeing her family and from making phone calls at a certain point.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他甚至试图阻止一位女友见家人和打电话。

sentences.en: He wanted...
sentences.zh: 他想要……

sentences.en: Sounds like somebody locking somebody in a room for six weeks.
sentences.zh: 听起来就像有人把别人关在房间里六周一样。

sentences.en: He wanted control.
sentences.zh: 他想要控制权。

sentences.en: So basically this is a portrait of, this is something of a psychological cliche, but someone who was hurt who goes on to do some real hurt.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上这是一幅画像，这在心理学上有点陈词滥调，但一个受过伤害的人，往往会继续去伤害别人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, what you see unfolding in the film is someone also at war with himself.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道，你在电影中看到的是一个同样在与自己交战的人。

sentences.en: You know, on the one hand, just this overwhelming creativity that was pouring out of him.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一方面，那种从他身上喷涌而出的压倒性的创造力。

sentences.en: And a desire to have people participate in that, but a constant pushing people away.
sentences.zh: 以及希望人们参与其中的渴望，但同时又不断地把人推开。

sentences.en: You know, he was a great elevator of women, for example.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他是一位伟大的女性提升者，举例来说。

sentences.en: He had many famous female collaborators, but many of those collaborators testify to the fact that he could be, you know, not only controlling,
sentences.zh: 他有很多著名的女性合作者，但其中许多人证实，他不仅控制欲强，

sentences.en: but kind of put them down and diminish them and make them feel worthless.
sentences.zh: 而且会贬低她们，削弱她们，让她们感到毫无价值。

sentences.en: And he could also be physically abusive.
sentences.zh: 而且他还会进行身体虐待。

sentences.en: So you hear from a girlfriend of his, a collaborator, Jill Jones, who talks about a moment when she flew into a jealous rage and Prince hit her and never apologized.
sentences.zh: 所以你听到他的女友、合作者Jill Jones谈到，有一次她陷入嫉妒的狂怒，Prince打了她，而且从未道歉。

sentences.en: And her anguish many years later is just totally vivid for the viewer.
sentences.zh: 多年后，她的痛苦对观众来说依然历历在目。

sentences.en: I wonder if you can explain, and I'm sure the film attempts to do this, how all of that pain, that anguish,
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否能解释，我相信电影也试图这样做，所有这些痛苦、那种煎熬，

sentences.en: all this biography influences and is ultimately responsible for Prince's music.
sentences.zh: 所有这些生平经历是如何影响并最终造就了Prince的音乐的。

sentences.en: Well, there's a great moment in the film where he's singing the beautiful ones.
sentences.zh: 嗯，电影里有一个很棒的时刻，他正在唱《The Beautiful Ones》。

sentences.en: You can find performances like this one online.
sentences.zh: 你可以在网上找到像这样的表演。

sentences.en: And, you know, one of the refrains is, do you want him or do you want me because I want you?
sentences.zh: 你知道，其中一句副歌是，你想要他还是想要我，因为我想要你？

sentences.en: It's the song of yearning.
sentences.zh: 这是一首渴望之歌。

sentences.en: And he is just giving a wild performance of a kind of screaming and keening and, you know, falling.
sentences.zh: 他正在进行一种狂野的表演，那种尖叫、哀鸣，你知道，跌倒。

sentences.en: And when I heard his, like, sort of yelps and his cries, I always thought it was about sexuality, you know, and sexual yearning, romantic yearning.
sentences.zh: 当我听到他那种类似尖叫和哭喊的声音时，我一直以为那是关于性，你知道，性渴望，浪漫的渴望。

sentences.en: But I was able to hear it in a different way.
sentences.zh: 但我能够以一种不同的方式去听它。

sentences.en: And partly because one of his bandmates is telling me, I hear her voice on the film telling me, this was the central problem of his life, this problem of abandonment.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是因为他的一位乐队成员告诉我，我在电影里听到她的声音告诉我，这是他生命中的核心问题，即被遗弃的问题。

sentences.en: Do you want me?
sentences.zh: 你想要我吗？

sentences.en: And you could hear the pure pain in it.
sentences.zh: 你能从中听到纯粹的痛苦。

sentences.en: And then suddenly Prince's screaming feels also like grief.
sentences.zh: 然后突然间，Prince的尖叫也感觉像是悲伤。

sentences.en: It's not just sexuality.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是性。

sentences.en: It's also grief.
sentences.zh: 也是悲伤。

sentences.en: It's also pain.
sentences.zh: 也是痛苦。

sentences.en: And it's authentic.
sentences.zh: 而且是真实的。

sentences.en: And I understand that the song contains all of it, you know.
sentences.zh: 我明白这首歌包含了所有这些，你知道。

sentences.en: So it's this richness.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种丰富性。

sentences.en: And you sort of understand what's feeding the performance.
sentences.zh: 你多少能理解是什么在滋养着这场表演。

sentences.en: And that when he's there on stage, like, yes, he's, I'm sure, aware of what he's doing and in control of what he's doing.
sentences.zh: 当他在舞台上时，是的，我相信他知道自己在做什么，并且掌控着自己所做的一切。

sentences.en: But he's also possessed and kind of channeling all of this complexity through his body and through his voice.
sentences.zh: 但他也被附体了，通过他的身体和声音传达着所有这些复杂的情感。

sentences.en: And I just hear his music completely differently now.
sentences.zh: 我现在完全以不同的方式听他的音乐了。

sentences.en: The layers are so much deeper.
sentences.zh: 层次深得多了。

sentences.en: So the movie is an answer to a cultural question that I think has been vexing us for a decade or more,
sentences.zh: 所以这部电影是对一个文化问题的回答，我认为这个问题已经困扰了我们十年甚至更久，

sentences.en: which is what do we do with great artists who are extremely flawed human beings?
sentences.zh: 那就是我们该如何对待那些本身有严重缺陷的伟大艺术家？

sentences.en: And the answer that the movie offers is that we basically sit with their contradictions, right?
sentences.zh: 电影给出的答案是，我们基本上要与他们的矛盾共存，对吧？

sentences.en: And Prince was, on the one hand, a genius, an original of a generation, an original of a century.
sentences.zh: Prince一方面是天才，是一代人的原创，是一个世纪的原创。

sentences.en: I mean, he's a Mozart of American pop.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他是美国流行音乐界的莫扎特。

sentences.en: And with a mind that was teeming with music and ideas, he was also controlling.
sentences.zh: 他的大脑里充满了音乐和想法，但他同时也具有控制欲。

sentences.en: He could be abusive towards his lovers.
sentences.zh: 他可能会虐待他的爱人。

sentences.en: He was deeply vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 他非常脆弱。

sentences.en: He was a person who crossed boundaries and contained multiplicities.
sentences.zh: 他是一个跨越界限并包含多种特质的人。

sentences.en: And Edelman is asking us to sit with that for nine hours and take it all in and allow ourselves to pity him sometimes,
sentences.zh: Edelman要求我们花九个小时去感受这一切，去包容它，允许我们有时去怜悯他，

sentences.en: allow ourselves to adore him and worship him and allow ourselves to criticize him and to sit with the wild brew of who Prince was.
sentences.zh: 允许我们去崇拜他，允许我们去批评他，去感受Prince这个人的复杂混合体。

sentences.en: And also to make the argument that knowing this enriches our understanding of the art he made, it deepens our understanding of the art he made,
sentences.zh: 同时也提出一个论点，即了解这些丰富了我们对他所创作艺术的理解，加深了我们对他所创作艺术的理解，

sentences.en: it deepens our love of it because we know where it comes from or we know something about where it comes from and how he transforms the raw material of his selfhood into something transcendent.
sentences.zh: 加深了我们对它的热爱，因为我们知道它来自哪里，或者我们知道它来源的一些信息，以及他是如何将自我原始的素材转化为某种超越性的东西的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 我是Wynna Liu。

sentences.zh: 我编写《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.zh: 我是Sam Azersky，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: So, Sasha, I think we've arrived at the moment in this conversation.
sentences.zh: 那么，Sasha，我想我们已经到了这次谈话的时刻了。

sentences.en: We've held it in suspense long enough where you just have to explain why it is, how it is, that this masterpiece is never going to be seen by anyone else.
sentences.zh: 我们已经悬念够久了，你必须解释一下为什么，它是如何发生的，这部杰作永远不会被其他人看到。

sentences.en: How that's possible, what the story there is.
sentences.zh: 这是怎么可能的，背后的故事是什么。

sentences.en: So, as part of the original agreement that Netflix struck with the Prince estate for access to the vault,
sentences.zh: 所以，作为Netflix与Prince遗产管理委员会达成协议以获取保险库访问权的一部分，

sentences.en: the estate was going to have an opportunity to review the film for factual accuracy.
sentences.zh: 遗产管理委员会将有机会审查这部电影的事实准确性。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Ezra Edelman welcomed this.
sentences.zh: Ezra Edelman对此表示欢迎。

sentences.en: He's a journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 他是一名记者。

sentences.en: He said, sure.
sentences.zh: 他说，没问题。

sentences.zh: 没人想出错。

sentences.en: Nobody wants to get anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 没人想出错。

sentences.en: You can review the film for factual error.
sentences.zh: 你们可以审查电影中的事实错误。

sentences.en: Now, in the years that Ezra spent working on the film, there were these ongoing, complicated legal battles over Prince's estate, in part because Prince left no will.
sentences.zh: 现在，在Ezra制作这部电影的几年里，关于Prince遗产的法律斗争一直在进行且复杂，部分原因是Prince没有留下遗嘱。

sentences.en: So, the estate changed hands.
sentences.zh: 所以，遗产易手了。

sentences.en: It changes from being overseen by a bank and courts in Minnesota to now being overseen by a lawyer who used to work for Prince in the 90s, members of his family,
sentences.zh: 它从由明尼苏达州的银行和法院监管，变成了现在由一位曾在90年代为Prince工作过的律师和他的家人成员共同监管，

sentences.en: and a music company.
sentences.zh: 还有一家音乐公司。

sentences.en: And the new people in charge watch the film, and they submit this list that's 17 pages long with all kinds of quibbles and queries and objections,
sentences.zh: 新上任的负责人看了这部电影，然后提交了一份长达17页的清单，里面全是各种吹毛求疵、质疑和反对意见，

sentences.en: almost none of which have to do with facts.
sentences.zh: 其中几乎没有一条是基于事实的。

sentences.en: And, I mean, I totally agree.

sentences.en: I think that when Ezra started making this film, it was a kind of heyday of prestige documentary.

sentences.en: And in the years since, documentaries have been transformed.

sentences.zh: 这个人是谁？

sentences.en: Why did he change characters?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要改变角色？

sentences.en: What was going on in his life at all those times?
sentences.zh: 在所有那些时候，他的生活中发生了什么？

sentences.en: And was I sensitive, by the way, as a black man taking on a black subject, knowing that people might think, oh, my God, why are you tearing this person down?
sentences.zh: 顺便问一下，作为一个黑人，我是否很敏感地对待一个黑人主题，因为我知道人们可能会想，天哪，你为什么要拆解这个人？

sentences.en: But also, why is warts and all such a terrible concept?
sentences.zh: 但同时，为什么“ warts and all”（不加掩饰的真实）是一个如此糟糕的概念？

sentences.en: Why is it not okay to know about a human?
sentences.zh: 为什么了解一个人是不可以的？

sentences.en: Especially, again, we get to have it both ways.
sentences.zh: 尤其是，再一次，我们两者兼得。

sentences.en: You just want to love his art but have him remain unexamined.
sentences.zh: 你只是想爱他的艺术，但让他保持不被审视的状态。

sentences.en: But if we examine him and you maybe are going to appreciate that art that you love so much even more, you might appreciate the struggle.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们审视他，你可能会更欣赏你如此热爱的艺术，你可能会欣赏其中的挣扎。

sentences.en: By the way, this guy got kicked out of his house when he was a teenager.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这家伙十几岁时就被赶出了家门。

sentences.en: He lived in the basement of his best friend.
sentences.zh: 他住在最好的朋友的地下室里。

sentences.en: He created himself out of whole cloth.
sentences.zh: 他白手起家创造了自己。

sentences.en: His will, his drive as a person, as an artist, the struggle he went through, that a guy, yeah, he happened to also be a genius, is unparalleled.
sentences.zh: 他的意志，他作为一个人、作为艺术家的动力，他经历的挣扎，一个家伙，是的，他恰好也是个天才，这是无与伦比的。

sentences.en: That's also what the movie's about.
sentences.zh: 这也是电影的主题。

sentences.en: Why can't we hold two truths together?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们不能同时接受两个事实？

sentences.en: It's not that hard.
sentences.zh: 这并不难。

sentences.en: These things go together.
sentences.zh: 这些东西是相辅相成的。

sentences.en: His genius, by the way, would not have wrought Prince, would not have created Prince.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，他的天才并不能造就王子，不能创造出王子。

sentences.en: Genius alone.
sentences.zh: 单凭天才是不够的。

sentences.en: No, genius plus drive, plus trauma.
sentences.zh: 不，是天才加上动力，再加上创伤。

sentences.en: Those are the things that created Prince.
sentences.zh: 正是这些东西造就了王子。

sentences.en: Why is that a hard thing?
sentences.zh: 为什么这很难接受呢？

sentences.en: Like, why can't we handle that?
sentences.zh: 就是说，为什么我们无法面对这一点？

sentences.en: Why can't the world handle that?
sentences.zh: 为什么世界无法面对这一点？

sentences.en: I don't understand it.
sentences.zh: 我不明白。

sentences.en: As far as this argument of, like, we...
sentences.zh: 就这个论点而言，比如，我们……

sentences.en: I think Ezra believes that for audiences to be given this, like, rich, chewy thing to engage with about this major icon would be satisfying for them.
sentences.zh: 我认为埃兹拉相信，如果能让观众接触到关于这位伟大偶像的丰富而耐人寻味的内容，他们会感到满足。

sentences.en: I want to ask you a somewhat provocative question.
sentences.zh: 我想问你一个有点挑衅性的问题。

sentences.en: This was an effort to demystify someone who, to a large degree, wanted to be unknowable.
sentences.zh: 这是一次试图揭开某人神秘面纱的尝试，而此人在很大程度上是希望保持不可知状态的。

sentences.en: And so, this outcome, as tragic as it must seem to Ezra Edelman, and clearly to you as someone who sees it as a masterpiece,
sentences.zh: 所以，这个结果，尽管在埃兹拉·埃德尔曼看来，显然在你这位将其视为杰作的人看来，一定显得非常悲剧，

sentences.en: is there any kind of cruel poetic justice here that this controlling artist who curated his image so carefully is going to remain, because of what happened here, unknowable?
sentences.zh: 这里面是否有一种残酷的诗意正义：这位精心打理自己形象、极具控制欲的艺术家，因为这里发生的事情，反而将永远保持不可知？

sentences.en: That he is weirdly getting the last word on what we all get to see of him.
sentences.zh: 他竟然以一种奇怪的方式，对自己留给世人的形象拥有了最终解释权。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I did often feel reporting this piece haunted by the presiding spirit of Prince and feeling like he was messing with all of us.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是说，在报道这个专题时，我确实经常感到被王子的灵魂所笼罩，感觉他是在捉弄我们所有人。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, I think, yes, there's a kind of, you know, cruel poetry to it all.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想，是的，这一切确实有一种残酷的诗意。

sentences.en: On the other hand, you know, Prince, at the end of his life, was opening up a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，你知道，王子在生命尽头，确实稍微敞开了一些心扉。

sentences.en: And the last hours of the film actually are about this.
sentences.zh: 电影的最后几个小时实际上就是关于这些的。

sentences.en: They're about a series of concerts that he gave.
sentences.zh: 它们是关于他举办的一系列音乐会。

sentences.en: Lo-fi, piano and a microphone, natural hair, where he was singing and talking and starting to talk about some of his pain, his childhood, his regrets, his loves.
sentences.zh: 低保真，只有钢琴和麦克风，自然的头发，他在那里唱歌、交谈，开始谈论他的一些痛苦、童年、遗憾和爱。

sentences.en: And it's still kind of veiled and perfumed, but it's more raw, and the style of performance is more raw.
sentences.zh: 虽然仍然带着面纱，充满神秘感，但它更真实，表演风格也更原始。

sentences.en: And he also was undertaking the writing of an autobiography.
sentences.zh: 而且他当时也在着手撰写自传。

sentences.en: And there was something happening.
sentences.zh: 有些事情正在发生。

sentences.en: I think he was changing.
sentences.zh: 我想他正在改变。

sentences.en: Maybe he did want to be more known.
sentences.zh: 也许他确实想让人们更多地了解他。

sentences.en: I think in some sense.
sentences.zh: 我想在某种意义上是这样。

sentences.en: I mean, look, probably on his own terMs.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你看，可能得按他自己的方式来。

sentences.en: But there's the question of what Prince would have wanted, and then there's also the question of, like, what's good for the culture in some way,
sentences.zh: 但问题在于，王子本人会想要什么，以及从某种程度上讲，什么对文化是有益的，

sentences.en: and what's good for the legacy of a person like Prince.
sentences.zh: 什么对像王子这样的人的遗产是有益的。

sentences.en: And actually, after the news of the film being finally killed broke, Jill Jones, who's the girlfriend that I was talking about before,
sentences.zh: 事实上，在电影最终被叫停的消息传出后，吉尔·琼斯，就是我之前提到的那位女朋友，

sentences.en: who was one of the people who appears in the film talking about Prince's abuse of her with a lot of pain,
sentences.zh: 她是出现在电影中、痛苦地讲述王子如何虐待她的人之一，

sentences.en: posted something that I thought was incredibly moving about what's wrong with this film not coming out.
sentences.zh: 发布了一些内容，我觉得非常感人，关于这部电影无法上映是多么可惜。

sentences.en: She was very in favor of the film coming out.
sentences.zh: 她非常支持这部电影上映。

sentences.en: Well, let me read you a little bit of it, because I think she says it really beautifully.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我为你读一点，因为我觉得她表达得非常优美。

sentences.en: So she says,
sentences.zh: 她是这样说的，

sentences.en: I thought that was something really extraordinary coming.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这真的很不寻常，

sentences.en: from someone who had been hurt by Prince, who saw some of the worst of Prince.
sentences.zh: 来自一个曾被王子伤害过、见识过王子最糟糕一面的人。

sentences.en: But she can hold that against, A, his greatness, but B, these sort of layers of pain that prevented him from being known.
sentences.zh: 但她能将这一点与他的伟大，以及那些阻碍他被了解的层层痛苦区分开来。

sentences.en: And she's saying, like, let's look at the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 她是说，让我们看看整体。

sentences.en: Because that's the way to really appreciate who this man was.
sentences.zh: 因为那是真正欣赏这个人的方式。

sentences.en: What she really seems to be saying is, to deny the world this film is to deny this man's full humanity and to hide it away.
sentences.zh: 她真正想说的是，拒绝让世界看到这部电影，就是拒绝承认这个人的完整人性，并将其掩盖起来。

sentences.en: And that only reinforces the idea that there's something wrong with being what all of us kind of are, which is damaged and complex.
sentences.zh: 这只会强化一种观念，即作为一个像我们所有人一样受过伤、复杂的人是有问题的。

sentences.en: And that this whole journey means that revealing the fullness of that experience is somehow intolerable.
sentences.zh: 而整个旅程意味着揭示这种体验的完整性在某种程度上是不可容忍的。

sentences.en: I think that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 我认为这完全正确。

sentences.en: And I think humanly, not only artistically, we have to make room for what's broken in us.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为在人性层面，不仅是在艺术层面，我们必须为我们破碎的部分留出空间。

sentences.en: And that's part of the story.
sentences.zh: 那是故事的一部分。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's the center of the story.
sentences.zh: 有时它是故事的核心。

sentences.en: And that's what Edelman has done here.
sentences.zh: 这就是埃德尔曼在这里所做的。

sentences.en: And yeah, I find it really, like, bitterly ironic what Jill Jones is saying.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得吉尔·琼斯所说的话带有极其苦涩的讽刺意味。

sentences.en: That, like, maybe in some way, one of Prince's deepest fears was that he would be seen and people would run away scared.
sentences.zh: 就像，也许在某种程度上，王子内心深处最恐惧的，就是他会被看穿，而人们会吓得跑开。

sentences.en: And that's what's happened.
sentences.zh: 而这正是所发生的事情。

sentences.en: So this leaves Ezra in a kind of existential limbo.
sentences.zh: 所以这让埃兹拉陷入了一种存在主义的困境。

sentences.en: And I know he's thinking a lot about his future as a filmmaker.
sentences.zh: 我知道他正在认真思考作为电影制作人的未来。

sentences.en: You know, we are only as strong as our own shoulders, after all.
sentences.zh: 你知道，毕竟我们能承担的压力是有限的。

sentences.en: And, like, it's like, am I built for it?
sentences.zh: 就像是，我能承受得住吗？

sentences.en: I might be built for it as a person, but am I actually anymore built for it?
sentences.zh: 作为一个个体我可能承受得住，但我还能承受得住吗？

sentences.en: And so, trust me, it's not like this is a loss of innocence.
sentences.zh: 所以，相信我，这并不是什么天真烂漫的幻灭。

sentences.en: I thought the world was great and people do the right things for the right reasons.
sentences.zh: 我曾以为世界很美好，人们会出于正当理由做正确的事。

sentences.en: But when it happens to you in this way, you're like, huh, okay.
sentences.zh: 但当这种事发生在你身上时，你会想，嗯，好吧。

sentences.en: It does change you a little bit.
sentences.zh: 它确实会让你改变一点。

sentences.en: It does sort of harden you.
sentences.zh: 它确实会让你变得坚硬一些。

sentences.en: A question in people's minds may be, like, where is the film?
sentences.zh: 人们心中可能有一个疑问，电影在哪里？

sentences.en: Like, where does it exist?
sentences.zh: 它存在于哪里？

sentences.en: Like, is the film itself in a vault?
sentences.zh: 电影本身是在保险库里吗？

sentences.en: Like, it's in a hard drive somewhere?
sentences.zh: 是在某个硬盘里吗？

sentences.en: I think the film exists, I mean, I assume it exists in Netflix somewhere.
sentences.zh: 我认为电影存在，我是说，我假设它存在于Netflix的某个地方。

sentences.en: I mean, this is the thing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: Now it is, like, I would go back and change the last shot of the film to, you know, there's a motif in the film of, you know,
sentences.zh: 现在是这样，我会回去修改电影的最后一个镜头，你知道，电影里有一个主题，你知道，

sentences.en: Prince made a few documentaries or shot a bunch of stuff.
sentences.zh: 王子制作过几部纪录片，或者拍摄过很多东西。

sentences.en: And so, each time, though, he decided, based on where he's at in life, that they weren't going to actually ever be seen.
sentences.zh: 但每一次，他都根据自己的人生阶段决定，这些东西永远不会被公开。

sentences.en: So, they went back in the vault.
sentences.zh: 所以，它们又回到了保险库里。

sentences.en: The point is, everything goes back in the vault.
sentences.zh: 重点是，一切都会回到保险库里。

sentences.en: You try to make a film, it goes back in the vault.
sentences.zh: 你试着拍一部电影，它又回到了保险库里。

sentences.en: So, I would now, if I could change the film, the last shot would be this whole thing, going back in the vault.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我现在能修改这部电影，最后一个镜头会是这一切，回到保险库里。

sentences.en: And the vault door would close.
sentences.zh: 然后保险库的门会关上。

sentences.en: And that's a wrap.
sentences.zh: 就这样结束了。

sentences.en: Ezra, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 埃兹拉，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: I always enjoy talking to you, Sasha.
sentences.zh: 我总是很享受和你交谈，萨莎。

sentences.en: You too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: Well, Sasha, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，萨莎，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: President Trump is suspending tariffs on most imports from Mexico and Canada for the next month in a concession to the country's leaders and to the U.S.

sentences.zh: 你会做这样的事吗？

sentences.zh: 你会说女性体育比赛中不允许有男性吗？

sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这是一个公平问题。

sentences.en: I completely agree with you on that.
sentences.zh: 在这点上我完全同意你的看法。

sentences.en: It is an issue of fairness.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一个公平问题。

sentences.en: So, it's deeply unfair.
sentences.zh: 所以，这非常不公平。

sentences.en: Would you speak out against this?
sentences.zh: 你会公开反对这一点吗？

sentences.en: Newsom, widely seen as a potential Democratic candidate for president in 2028,
sentences.zh: 纽森被广泛视为2028年总统大选的潜在民主党候选人，

sentences.zh: 他在接受保守派播客主持人查理·柯克的采访时发表了这一声明，当时民主党人正在努力应对特朗普总统的胜利，以及该党在社会议题上的立场，
